items.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
items.snippet: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. items.title_ar: System 1 agents: طريقة لبناء agents محلية وموثوقة وسريعة
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث منهجية لبناء System 1 agents، وهي agents محلية تستدعي الأدوات دون توليد نص. يحوّل compiler حتمي الـ schema والطلب إلى أسئلة multiple-choice يجيب عنها decision model في مرور واحد. على 1,952 طلباً لـ157 أداة biomedical، حقق أفضل agent دقة 97.0% في اختيار الأداة أو الرفض الصحيح.
items.why_ar: يهمك لأنه يعالج بناء agents على بيانات حساسة محلياً دون إرسالها إلى cloud LLMs.
items.title_en: System 1 agents: local, reliable and fast agentic AI
items.summary_en: The paper proposes System 1 agents, local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns tool schemas and requests into multiple-choice questions answered by a one-pass decision model. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best agent chose the right tool or correctly declined in 97.0% of cases.
items.why_en: It shows how to build reliable tool-calling agents on sensitive data without sending it to cloud LLMs.

The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely…

items.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.snippet: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. items.title_ar: RL Post-Training في Diffusion Transformers هو في جوهره Activation Steering
items.summary_ar: تختبر الورقة نماذج diffusion transformers المدربة بـ RL باستخدام steering vectors ثابتة تضاف إلى block outputs للموديل الأساسي المجمّد. على SD3.5-M تستخدم هذه المتجهات 65 مرة بارامتر أقل من LoRA المدرب بـ RL، وتقيس الورقة نسبة مكاسب الجودة وtext rendering والتركيب التي تفسرها إزاحة مستقلة عن المدخل.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تعمل على تخصيص generative models، فهذه الورقة تقدم بديلاً أخف بكثير من LoRA لتجربة تحسينات مشابهة.
items.title_en: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.summary_en: The paper probes RL-tuned diffusion transformers with a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M these vectors use 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against about 18M). The study asks how much of the RL gains in visual quality, text rendering and composition can be explained by an input-independent shift.
items.why_en: If you fine-tune generative models, it suggests a much lighter alternative to LoRA for testing similar improvements.

items.title: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
items.snippet: Optical neural networks promise fast, energy-efficient computing, but every device departs from its design and must be trained with the hardware. In situ training relies on an expert-built calibrated digital model of each device or on gradient-free trial and error. Coding agents, large language models that write and run programs, have shown an emergent ability to understand and edit the weights of digital neural networks. items.title_ar: Optics as Code: تدريب Optical Neural Networks بواسطة coding agents
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة طريقة optics as code يدرب فيها coding agent شبكة optical neural network من القياسات وحدها دون نموذج رقمي معايَر للجهاز. يعمل agent عبر harness يعيد صور الكاميرا للمجسات ويطلب فرضية مع كل طلب. يبدو أن agent يكوّن فهماً فيزيائياً للجهاز أثناء التدريب.
items.why_ar: يوضح تجربة coding agents على تجارب فيزيائية قائمة على الفرضيات، وهذا نمط قد يلهم تصميم تجاربك على الـ agents.
items.title_en: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
items.summary_en: The paper introduces optics as code, a method in which a coding agent trains an optical neural network from measurements alone. The agent works through a harness that returns camera images of its probes and requires a hypothesis per request. The authors report that the agent appears to form a physical understanding of the device during training.
items.why_en: It shows coding agents running hypothesis-driven experiments on hardware, a workflow pattern that can inform your own agent experiments.

items.title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
items.snippet: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case. To mitigate these issues, this work introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD): a sound and complete constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity. items.title_ar: ITPD لتعلم هيكل السلاسل الزمنية السببية
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة طريقة Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery لتعلم البنية السببية في السلاسل الزمنية متعددة المتغيرات. تكتشف الطريقة الآباء السببيين محلياً ثم تبني الرسم البياني العام تدريجياً. وتستهدف الورقة حالات عدم الاستقرار السببي عبر الزمن.

items.title_en: ITPD: Learning causal structure in time series locally
items.summary_en: The paper introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery, a constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series. It builds the global graph by sequentially finding local causal parents. The method targets causal nonstationarity, where relationships change over time.
items.why_en: Causal analysis of time series can support risk and fraud models built on transaction data over time.

items.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
items.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides
items.title_ar: تدريب نماذج VLA على التوقف الآمن أثناء التنفيذ
items.summary_ar: تبين الورقة أن سياسات VLA التي تمنع مهمة من حالتها الأولية قد تكملها عند التدخل في منتصف التنفيذ. قد يسقط الروبوت الجسم الممسوك حتى إذا بقيت المهمة غير مكتملة، لذلك لا يكفي عدم الإكمال مقياساً للأمان. تقدم الورقة طريقة SAFI للمهام التي يمسك فيها الروبوت شيئاً.
items.why_ar: أمان الأنظمة الذكية التي تتصرف في العالم الفعلي يقدم دروساً عامة حول سلوك الرجوع الآمن لأي نظام agent.
items.title_en: Teaching VLA models to stop safely mid-execution
items.summary_en: The paper finds that VLA policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over mid-execution. The robot may drop a held object even when the task stays unfinished, so non-completion is an incomplete safety measure. It introduces State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks involving holding objects.
items.why_en: Safety of agentic AI systems that act in the physical world offers general lessons on fallback behavior.

items.summary_ar: تشارك جهة سعودية في تطوير تقنية AI لرصد اضطرابات النوم بدقة تبلغ 92.9%. لم يذكر الخبر تفاصيل عن النموذج أو البيانات أو طريقة الوصول إليه.
items.why_ar: يهم المهندس كمثال على تطبيقات AI سعودية في مجال الصحة، مع إمكانية الاطلاع على منهجيتها عند توفرها.
items.title_en: Saudi-backed AI tool detects sleep disorders with 92.9% accuracy
items.summary_en: A Saudi participant helped develop an AI technology for detecting sleep disorders with 92.9% accuracy. The report gives no details on the model, data, or how it can be accessed.
items.why_en: It matters to you as an example of Saudi AI applications in health, though the methodology is not yet available.

items.snippet: Mint AI and Aqel sign MoU for a strategic partnership in AI infrastructure in Qatar and Saudi Arabia | Gulf Times Gulf Times
items.title_ar: Mint AI وAqel توقعان مذكرة تفاهم لبنية AI تحتية في قطر والسعودية
items.summary_ar: وقعت Mint AI وAqel مذكرة تفاهم لشراكة استراتيجية في بنية AI التحتية داخل قطر والسعودية. لم يتضمن الخبر تفاصيل تقنية عن القدرات أو الجدول الزمني.
items.why_ar: يهم المهندس لأن البنية التحتية للـ GPU والـ inference في المنطقة قد تؤثر على خيارات النشر في البنك.
items.title_en: Mint AI and Aqel sign AI infrastructure MoU for Qatar and Saudi Arabia
items.summary_en: Mint AI and Aqel signed an MoU for a strategic partnership in AI infrastructure across Qatar and Saudi Arabia. The report includes no technical details on capacity or timeline.
items.why_en: It matters to you because regional AI infrastructure partnerships can affect GPU and inference hosting options for bank deployments.
